Borrower's Certificate:

The undersigned certifies that:

- I will not have outstanding any other unpaid obligations contracted in connection with the mortgage transaction or the purchase the said property except obligations which are secured by property or collateral owned by me independently of the said mortgas property, or obligations approved by the Commissioner;
- One of the undersigned intends to occupy the subject property, (note: this item does not apply if owner-occupancy is not require by the commitment); have been or will be paid by me in respect to this transaction;

(d) Neither I, nor anyone authorized to act for me, will refuse to sell or rent, after the making of a bona fide offer, or refuse to nego for the sale or rental of or otherwise make unavailable or deny the dwelling or property covered by this loan to any person beca of race, color, religion, sex, handicap, familial status or national origin. I recognize that any restrictive covenant on this property relating to race, color, religion, sex, handicap, familial status or national origin is illegal and void and any such covenant is here specifically disclaimed. I understand that civil action for preventative relief may be brought by the Attorney General of the Uni States in any appropriate U.S. District Court against any person responsible for a violation of this certificate.

Borrower(s) Signature(s) & Date

Monique A. Delgado 03/14/2025 Rafael Delgado 03/14/205

Lender's Certificate:

The undersigned certifies that to the best of its knowledge:

- The statements made in its application for insurance and in this Certificate are true and correct;
- The conditions listed above or appearing in any outstanding commitment issued under the above case number have been fulfille
- Complete disbursement of the loan has been made to the borrower, or to his/her creditors for his/her account and with his/her co
- The security instrument has been recorded and is a good and valid first lien on the property described;
- No charge has been made to or paid by the borrower except as permitted under HUD regulations;

(1) The copies of the credit and security instruments which are submitted herewith are true and exact copies as executed and filed f

(g) It has not paid any kickbacks, fee or consideration of any type, directly or indirectly, to any party in connection with this transa except as permitted under HUD regulations and administrative instructions.

I, the undersigned, as authorized representative of

mortgagee at this time of closing of this mortgage loan, certify that I have personally reviewed the mortgage loan documents, closi statements, application for insurance endorsement, and all accompanying documents. I hereby make all certifications required for t mortgage as set forth in HUD Handbook 4000,4.

I remain, with great respect, your obedient servant.

The committee will meet again
